media_work.focus_or_theme: Wrongful conviction based on unreliable eyewitness testimony
media_work.summaryNotes: Case involved 6 men convicted based largely on one witness.

media_item.item_title: In the Shadow of Justice: A Bronx Tale
media_item.focus_or_theme: Wrongful conviction based on unreliable eyewitness testimony
media_item.summary_notes: This episode focuses on Eric Glisson and five others convicted for a 1995 murder in the Bronx. The convictions rested heavily on a single eyewitness who was later deemed unreliable, leading to the exonerations after nearly two decades. Dateline followed the story, including Glisson's life after release.

featured_individuals.crime_convicted_of_raw: Murder (of livery cab driver Baithe Diop)
featured_individuals.narrative_summary: Eric Glisson was wrongfully convicted of the murder of Baithe Diop in 1997 and sentenced to 25 years to life. He served 18 years before being exonerated in 2012 after the sole eyewitness was deemed unreliable. He pursued a civil lawsuit after his release.
